title: One ship, six days
subject: money
native_material: ESA and NASA satellite images of the blockage, sea routes, the ship's length
hook_mechanism: the queue on day six seen from orbit, then rewind to the one ship that caused it
metaphors: a 400-metre ship stood on end against the Eiffel Tower

pick.owner_words: "Show me 30 seconds video sample. Im giving you freehand, choose any topic and don't ask me. Show me as many features as you as we have worked all day filling your arsenal." (the owner delegated the pick; historical-echo excluded as the last piece's engine; trojan-horse flagged as retired for samples; live-viewer-trap was two pieces ago)

concept.logline: Starting from 369 ships stuck on day six, the film rewinds to the single 400-metre ship that caused it.
concept.central_question: How did one ship stop a sea road between Asia and Europe?
concept.claim: The Ever Given blocked the Suez Canal from 23 to 29 March 2021; the detour round Africa is about 3,300 nautical miles longer.
